johnisanerd-claude-skill-linkedin-post-e.description: Analyze LinkedIn post engagement with the Apify LinkedIn Posts API Actor (johnvc/linkedin-posts-api). Collect a profile's posts or a list of post URLs, then measure reactions, comments, and shares alongside author reach (followers, headline) to see what performs. Use when the user wants to analyze LinkedIn post engagement, measure engagement rate, find a creator's or a competitor's top-performing posts, benchmark engagement across profiles, track post engagement over time, or build a LinkedIn engagement report.
